question: The Mettur Dam is on which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cauvery**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Mettur Dam is one of the largest dams in India and also the largest in Tamil Nadu, located across the river Cauvery.
 
• Mettur is known for its huge dam, power generation, chemical manufacturing, and aluminium production.
 
• Most of the water requirements for irrigation in Tamil Nadu is provided by the Mettur Dam.
 
• The Mettur Dam is also called Stanley Reservoir.
 
• The dam was made in the year 1934 (after 9 years of foundation stone).
 
• The maximum height and width of the dam are 214 and 171 feet respectively.
